correctness.rationale: Under the precise definition of even binary length-2n words and complementary ordered length-n subsequences U,V with V=πU, for n=2..6 cyclic shifts k=0..floor(n/2) cover ALL 2^(2n-1) even words, proved by a finite exhaustive upper certificate. For lower bounds, exhausting every permutation and subsequence partition yields best one-permutation covers 6/8,28/32 at n=2,3 and best two-permutation unions 126/128,496/512 at n=4,5. At n=6 the given nine-word obstruction generates 73 distinct coverage signatures from all 720 permutations and all 924 partitions; a complete 9-bit superset DP rules out every triple of signatures. Thus m2(2..6)=(2,2,3,3,4), with no assumption that lower-bound competitors are cyclic. Independent fresh exhaustive enumeration regenerated signatures, rotation coverage for 8,32,128,512,2048 words and nine-word obstruction; a subset witness is sufficient for the lower bound, not a mistaken all-word enumeration.
